prompt: Respond entirely in Igbo. Use simple language for a Nigerian cybersecurity beginner. Give a practical, safe explanation. Explain how a banking customer should recognise a suspicious account-verification message.
response:
(1) Ịmata ozi nkwenye aka nke na-adịghị mma: Ozi sitere na adreesị email ma ọ bụ nọmba ekwentị ị maghị, yana akara ngosi na-ezighi ezi ma ọ bụ enweghị ihe ọ pụtara.

(2) Ihe egwu dị na ya: Ozi ndị a nwere ike bute izu ohi data gị, imebi ego gị, ma ọ bụ ịbanye na akaụntụ gị na-enweghị ikike gị.

(3) Nzọụkwụ nchekwa: Lelee ozi ahụ site na ngwa ụlọ akụ gị ma ọ bụ site na nọmba ị hụrụ n'anya ka ijide n'aka na ọ bụ ezigbo onye zitere ya. Ekwela ka mmadụ mara okwuntughe gị, PIN, ma ọ bụ Koodu Oge Otu (OTP). Naanị otu koodu na-abịa otu ugboro maka nchebe kacha mma.

prompt: Respond entirely in Igbo. Use simple language for a Nigerian cybersecurity beginner. Give a practical, safe explanation. Explain multi-factor authentication and why it protects online accounts.
response:
(1) Multi-factor authentication (MFA) bụ usoro nchekwa ebe chọrọ ihe abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa iji kwado njirimara onye na-ahụ maka akaụntụ akpaaka.

(2) Ihe egwu dị na ịnweta akaụntụ gị na-enweghị MFA bụ na onye na-ezighi ezi nwere ike nweta ya site na naanị aha njirimara gị, nke pụtara na ha ga-amata okwuntughe gị wee banye.

(3) Iji chekwaa akaụntụ gị, jiri MFA mee ka nkwenye gị sie ike. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, tinye PIN koodu sitere na ngwa nbanye ekwentị gị mgbe ị na-abanye na akaụntụ ụlọ akụ gị.
